{{Quote|The only Jedi we can spare are Skywalker and Kenobi. They just captured the planet Christophsis.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="TCWf">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>}}
'''Christophsis''' was a [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector]]. [[Orbit/Legends|Orbited]] by a [[Christophsis's moon/Legends|single moon]] amongst the mineral-rich [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] of the [[Christoph system/Legends|Christoph system]], Christophsis was for a [[Time/Legends|time]] a target for stray rocks because of its closeness to various [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belts]], but the planet was refined by [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]] nobles around [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]], and later by the world's native [[Christophsian/Legends|Christophsian]] inhabitants, who originated as [[Human/Legends|Humans]] from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]]. Christophsis was eventually protected from the asteroids and transformed into the center of a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] hub. By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Christophsians ruled their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] in a [[Christophsis oligarchy|mercantile oligarchy]] and had established [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Chaleydonia]], also known as Crystal City, as their planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. Various [[Species/Legends|species]] also immigrated to the world, including [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Kerkoiden/Legends|Kerkoidens]], and lower-caste Humans who came to serve the Christophsians.

All of the Christophsians' hard work was ultimately crippled when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]-backed [[Retail Caucus/Legends|Retail Caucus]] conglomerate seized Christophsis in the [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]] of the Clone Wars, with the feared [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] [[Christophsis blockade/Legends|blockading]] Christophsis and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]] subjugating the Christophsian people. Although a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led battle group from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] eventually [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|liberated]] Christophsis, the costly [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] victory reduced several key [[City/Legends|cities]] to rubble. The Separatists later returned to the planet to mine for its crystals to fuel their new [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the ''[[Devastation]]'', a plot that was [[Mission to Christophsis (Confederacy mining)|halted]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Eventually, with the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], Christophsis reluctantly became part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but ignored all of the following [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] governments.

==Description==
[[File:Christophsis_landscape.png|thumb|left|250px|The crystalline landscape of Christophsis]]
Situated on the major [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] and close to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of Christophsis was the only planet in the [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector's]] [[Christoph system/Legends|Christoph system]] with an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] that could support life. Christophsis [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] of [[Christoph]]<ref name="The Essential Atlas" /> with its [[Christophsis's moon/Legends|single moon]] as a companion<ref name="Cat and Mouse" /> and had a temperate climate and a terrestrial terrain. The planet was famous for the beauty of its nearby [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belts]]&mdash;[[the Barren]], [[the Hammers]], and [[the Halo]]&mdash;but its location close to the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] often made it a target for stray rocks.<ref name="The Essential Atlas" /> Foodstuffs were one of the planet's few imports,<ref name="TCWCG" /> but the asteroid belts of the system were abundant in raw materials. Among the planet's other exports were artwork and industrial goods.<ref name="The Essential Atlas" />

Christophsis was covered in massive green-blue hexagonal [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]], which were also suitable for use as [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]]. The inhabitants of Christophsis took advantage of the natural spires, building [[City/Legends|cities]] into and around the crystalline formations and using the crystals' solid structures for foundation and support;<ref name="TCWCG" /> the size of the world's buildings often varied with the size of their supporting crystals.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy">{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy}}</ref> Some of the world's cities were so large that they could be seen from [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="TCWf" /> From time to time, solar storms ripped through the upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of Christophsis.<ref name="TCWn" />

==History==
===The mining hub===
[[File:Christophsis_TEA.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Another view of Christophsis]]Christophsis was ruled by a [[Christophsis oligarchy|mercantile oligarchy]], and for millennia, the planet's asteroid belts proved beautiful to observers and dangerous to those that tried to profit from [[Mining/Legends|mining]] them. The belts were chaotic, and stray rocks regularly found their way to Christophsis, often with abrupt and destructive entrances. Around [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]], a family of [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]] nobles made the investments necessary to transform the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] into a worthwhile mining concern. Over the course of a century, the planet's native [[Christophsian/Legends|Christophsian]] inhabitants hired [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] mathematicians to plot the courses of numerous asteroids in order to eliminate those that proved a threat to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. The Christophsians also paid [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] technologists to refine [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and mining technologies that would allow people to work in the dangerous asteroid belts.<ref name="The Essential Atlas" />

Both came at a massive expense, but the Christophsians' investment in the [[Alien/Legends|aliens]]' services paid off when repositories of [[chanlon]], [[hfredium]], [[Quadrillium/Legends|quadrillium]], and [[Nergon-14/Legends|Nergon-14]] minerals were found to be abundant in the surrounding asteroids. Unwilling to share their profitable materials with their accomplices, the Christophsians hired the best [[Vippit]] lawyers to disenfranchise their Givin and Verpine partners. The planet's inhabitants renamed the system to "Christoph" in their own honor, and the system's richness in raw materials eventually transformed it into a mining haven.<ref name="The Essential Atlas" /> The world's natural crystals were also used as exports.<ref name="TCWCG" />

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Your technology will not save you, and your friends on the planet below shall perish as a result of your ''failure''. The people of Christophsis and her resources shall join the Separatist Alliance.|Admiral Trench, in a message to his Republic opponents|<ref name="Cat and Mouse" />}}
By the time of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Christophsis oligarchs' mining expertise and manipulation of mineral markets had, albeit grudgingly, won admiration from the rest of the galaxy. However, the Christophsian rulers were also viewed with suspicion for their secrecy and self-absorption. High-ranking members of the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]] that visited the system were rarely invited to Christophsis itself, and were instead received in the Halo's utilitarian space habitats. The Christophsians' ways became so developed that the planet's populace was rumored to live luxurious lives and [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] and [[Kerkoiden/Legends|Kerkoiden]] immigrants and lower-caste [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas" /> The city of [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Chaleydonia]], more commonly known as Crystal City,<ref name="Shadow Games" /> served as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Christophsis.<ref name="TCWCG" /><ref name="Shadow Games" />

====Confederacy invasion====
{{Quote|You be listening to the voice of the Confederacy o' Independent Systems. Yer planet, it belongs to us now. We have taken over yer communication systems. Yer planetary leadership has abandoned you. They've ceded yer world to our cause&hellip; You are no longer in the Republic. You are no longer beholden to their laws. Yer world's resources will be transferred to the Confederacy. We wage this war for yer independence. Do not resist our efforts. Remain vigilant for Republic reprisals.|Whorm Loathsom, to the Christophsis populace|<ref name="Shadowed">''[[The Clone Wars: Shadowed]]''</ref>}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="SW">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> after the Clone Wars had begun, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] invaded Christophsis, seeking to force the crystalline planet into joining its [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|cause]]. The oligarchy abandoned the population, and over a massive [[Hologram/Legends|holotransmission]], the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]]<ref name="Shadowed" />&mdash;the leader of the army of the [[Retail Caucus/Legends|Retail Caucus]], a conglomerate of the Confederacy<ref name="TCWCG" />&mdash;ordered the planet's inhabitants to submit to Separatist rule.<ref name="Shadowed" /> At some point after the Confederacy's invasion, a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] was sent to Christophsis to [[Mission to Christophsis (datapacks)|retrieve]] [[Datacard/Legends|datapacks]] before the Separatists could get their hands on them.<ref name="Live Fire">{{SWArchive|url=games/playnow/livefire|text=LiveFire|int=LiveFire}}</ref>

[[File:Confederacy_invades_Christophsis.png|thumb|right|250px|Christophsians attempt to defend their home.]]
As the Christophsians unsuccessfully attempted to defend their home against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], they appealed to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] for assistance, and a faction of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] was dispatched under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|liberate]] the Outer Rim world.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> By the time the Jedi had broken through the Separatist [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] surrounding Christophsis<ref name="Republic Heroes DS">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition</ref> and landed their ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]] on the planet, the civilian population had already fled.<ref name="TCWn" /> The Republic forces landed in Crystal City<ref name="Art of SW:TCW">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref> and set up a [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|base]]. [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick]] and [[Slick's squad/Legends|his unit]] of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were sent to reconnoiter a suitable location from which to ambush the Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Locating a [[Christophsis double-towered building/Legends|business center]] with towers facing the north and south and overlooking a major plaza, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Slick and his men headed back to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] base.<ref name="Shadowed" />

On its way back, the squad came across [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] that were attempting to clear one of the city's main boulevards of Christophsians. The battle droids discovered a crippled refugee and discussed killing the man, but the Christophsians diverted the droids' attention to the clones, who intervened and eliminated the droids.<ref name="Shadowed" /> After returning to the base, however, Slick&mdash;who had become fed up with his position in the Grand Army as a virtual slave to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and become a Confederate [[Spy/Legends|spy]]&mdash;secretly transmitted the Republic's intended battle plan<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> to General Loathsom and the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], who had arrived on the planet.<ref name="Shadowed" /> Preparing to ambush the Confederate droid forces, Kenobi, [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]], and Slick stationed their men in the South tower, while Skywalker and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] were based in the parallel North tower. Acting on Slick's information, a squad of B1 battle droids ambushed Kenobi in the South tower, and Skywalker's men used [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hooks]] to traverse the gap between the buildings and enter the adjacent South tower.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

The Republic forces were able to escape from the roof of the South tower via [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[Hawk/Legends|Hawk's]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]]. Back at the Republic base, CC-2224 and CT-7567&mdash;nicknamed Cody and Rex, respectively&mdash;[[Robolobotomy/Legends|examined]] the stolen cranial unit of a [[TJ-55/Legends|Confederate tactical droid]], but the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|droid]] only confirmed that the Confederacy had been aware of the Republic's plan before it stopped processing. Suspecting that there was a traitor amongst their troops, Skywalker and Kenobi left on a mission to infiltrate enemy lines to search for the instigator behind the ambushes, while Rex and Cody stated to find the Confederate spy.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> Arriving at a [[Christophsis Separatist headquarters/Legends|23-story mansion]] that the Separatists had taken over and made headquarters out of,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Decoded">{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy|d=y}}</ref> Skywalker and Kenobi were greeted by Ventress, and engaged the Dark Acolyte in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]]. Luring the Jedi to the roof of the building, Ventress revealed a massive battle droid army in greater size than the Republic had originally believed, stating that the Confederacy was preparing to assume control of the world.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

The two Jedi briefly continued the duel before fleeing on stolen [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]], and Ventress relayed orders through a [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Christophsis)/Legends|tactical droid]] to Loathsom. Ordering the [[Kerkoiden/Legends|Kerkoiden]] general to march on the city, the Dark Acolyte left the planet in her ship, the [[Trident (starship)/Legends|''Trident'']], to execute a mission for her [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. Meanwhile, having traced an irregular wavelength to a terminal in Sergeant Slick's barracks, Cody and Rex proceeded to individually interrogate Slick's men, believing that one of them was the traitor. Slick himself was eventually revealed to be the spy, and managed to sabotage the Republic's weapons depot, [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] landing platform, and [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walkers]] with several pre-planted explosives. Cody and Rex fought the Separatist spy in the base's command center and apprehended the clone turncoat. As dawn broke on Christophsis, the Jedi returned, and although the Republic forces were only able to salvage their [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|artillery guns]] from the destroyed weapons depot, they regrouped and prepared to fight the Confederacy.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

[[File:Battle_of_Christophsis_2.png|thumb|left|250px|Confederate [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] advance through the main street of Crystal City.]]
The Confederacy launched an attack on the Republic forces in Crystal City, and Kenobi and Skywalker fought the first wave of Loathsom's battle droids. After several days, the Confederacy was forced to retreat, but the initial stages of the battle caused many Christophsian civilian casualties. Soon after the Republic [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Hunter (cruiser)|''Hunter'']]&mdash;under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]]&mdash;was dispatched for supplies, Loathsom and his droid forces launched another assault, marching straight through the main street of the city toward the Republic forces. While Skywalker, Rex, and the [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] [[Company/Legends|unit]] made their way through sidestreets and behind the droid lines, surprising several advancing [[Octuptarra magna tri-droid/Legends|Octuptarra magna tri-droids]] from above, Kenobi led [[Ghost Squadron]] in a charge on the Separatists' front lines. With the Republic's [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] cover, Loathsom was forced to retreat once more.<ref name="TCWn" /><ref name="TCWf" />

A [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] arrived from the galactic capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and landed in [[City Plaza (Christophsis)|City Plaza]], but in place of the Republic's expected reinforcements was young [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who had been recently apprenticed by Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to Skywalker. From the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] that had delivered Tano, the Jedi contacted Master Yoda&mdash;who had been unaware of their predicament of being stranded on Christophsis&mdash;and requested reinforcements, but the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] was damaged under increasing fire from the Confederate [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] surrounding the planet and was forced to retreat.<ref name="TCWn" /><ref name="TCWf" /> Loathsom launched yet another attack, this time advancing his forces in two groups from the south and the east. Kenobi and [[Alpha Squad (Galactic Republic)|Alpha Squad]] halted the south force's approach, but [[Bravo Squad (Galactic Republic)|Bravo Squad]] was unable to stop the east force's advance. The Separatists advanced behind an expanding [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]], which effectively negated the Republic's use of long-ranged artillery.<ref name="Republic Heroes DS" /> Kenobi and Rex marshaled a defense of the Republic base, while Skywalker and Tano infiltrated the droid lines to destroy the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]].<ref name="TCWn" /><ref name="TCWf" />

The shield soon passed over the Republic forces in Crystal City, and Kenobi led the clones to attack the droids, attempting to draw the Confederacy into the buildings and gain an advantage over them. While Kenobi pretended to surrender to Loathsom in order to gain time for Skywalker and Tano, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Rex retreated to defend the heavy cannons with the rest of the troops. After fighting [[LR-57 combat droid/Legends|LR-57 combat droids]] that were guarding the generator, Skywalker and Tano were able to plant explosives and destroy the generator. As the shield receded, Kenobi captured Loathsom and took the Kerkoiden captive. Returning to Christophsis in the ''[[Spirit of the Republic]]'' and several other Attack Cruisers, Admiral Yularen finally arrived with reinforcements and was able to break through the Confederate blockade, forcing the enemy armada to retreat. The Republic cruisers landed, along with several clone trooper units as further reinforcements on the liberated Christophsis.<ref name="TCWn" /><ref name="TCWf" /> However, the costly Republic victory had reduced several key cities to rubble, leaving many in the galaxy secretly cheering the damage that had been done.<ref name="The Essential Atlas" />

====Crystal mining====
{{Quote|There's definitely something suspicious happening on Christophsis. The Separatist Army appears to be mining for something.|Padmé Amidala, to the Jedi Council|<ref name="Jedi Alliance" />}}
Later in the war, the Separatist Droid Army set up a [[Christophsis Separatist mining base|base]] near the planet's core to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] for its crystals.<ref name="Jedi Alliance" /> Because Christophsis's crystals could be used to power lightsabers,<ref name="TCWCG" /> the Confederacy planned to use them to power its new [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the ''[[Devastation]]'', which was powered by Force-activated crystals. After the Republic [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Sedawan]]''{{'s}} supply of lightsaber crystals was [[Battle on the Sedawan|raided]], the Jedi Council began to come onto the Confederacy's plan. During the analysis of data provided by the turncoat [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Ros Lai]], the Jedi Council enlisted [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] help. Traveling to Christophsis with Captain Rex, the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], Amidala [[Mission to Christophsis (Confederacy mining)|discovered]] that the Confederacy was mining for something and reported her findings to the Council. Before the group could leave the planet, however, their ship was shot down, and Captain Rex was injured in the crash. The group was taken captive and placed in a holding cell inside the Separatist base.<ref name="Jedi Alliance" />

A team of two Jedi was sent with Clone Commander [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|CC-1004]], nicknamed "Gree," and an LAAT/i gunship to rescue Senator Amidala. However, the gunship was shot down over the planet as well and skidded toward the edge of a cliff. Gree told the two Jedi to continue the mission themselves, and the LAAT/i soon dislodged from the cliff and plummeted into the depths of Christophsis. Unable to help Gree, the Jedi entered the Separatist base and began to search for Amidala. Fighting [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]] and several of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]&ndash;wielding Nightsisters themselves, the two Jedi discovered that a few of the Christophsis crystals were harnessing [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] itself. On the exterior of the facility, the two Jedi fought a group of Nightsisters before Commander Gree&mdash;having recovered his gunship&mdash;and his vessel arrived and opened fire on the dark side practitioners, defeating them. The Jedi ordered the clone commander to find a nearby landing site while they continued the search for Senator Amidala.<ref name="Jedi Alliance" /><ref name="Jedi Alliance Pairs">In ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance]]'', the two Jedi who are sent to Christophsis can be any pair of these six: [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]. The game's [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance: Prima Official Game Guide|Prima Guide]] uses Kenobi and Skywalker, but they are not necessarily the [[canon]]ical choice.</ref>

[[File:ChristophsisCISMiningBase-TCWJA.jpg|thumb|right|220px|R2-D2 and C-3PO inside the Separatist mining base]]
Re-entering the Separatist base, the two Jedi fought more Nightsisters before finding and freeing Senator Amidala, Captain Rex, R2-D2, and C-3PO from their holding cell. Amidala reported that they had overheard the Separatists confirming that they were harvesting crystals from the planet core, and the Jedi questioned why the Confederacy was after lightsaber crystals&mdash;first the ''Sedawan''{{'s}} cargo of lightsaber crystals had been stolen, and now the Confederacy was mining on Christophsis. While Amidala took Rex, who had been injured when the ship crashed, to Gree's transport, R2-D2 and C-3PO stayed with the Jedi to assist in the continuing investigation. The two Republic droids went to find the facility's central computer, but were discovered by B1 battle droids and forced to pose as configuration droids. R2-D2 and C-3PO regulated the temperate of a large crystal, but were also able to gain and transmit the coordinates of Gree's gunship&mdash;which had been forced to relocate itself&mdash;to Amidala.<ref name="Jedi Alliance" /><ref name="Jedi Alliance Pairs" />

Elsewhere in the facility, the two Jedi were ambushed by battle droids. From a computer terminal, R2-D2 and C-3PO opened a door and provided the Jedi with an escape, and also discovered the location of the ''Devastation'', which they immediately sent to the Jedi Council. The pair of Jedi were then confronted by B1 battle droids, and the two Republic droids accidentally stumbled across a [[boss miner droid]]. R2-D2 and C-3PO trapped the mining droid in the hallway it was advancing through before activating a mechanism that squashed the B1 battle droids attacking the Jedi. With their battle droid adversaries disabled, the two Jedi found the ''Sedawan''{{'s}} stolen lightsaber crystals before Count Dooku himself appeared and escaped with the supply of crystals. Thanks to the discovered location of the ''Devastation'', a team of Jedi managed to [[Battle on the Devastation|infiltrate and destroy]] the [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]].<ref name="Jedi Alliance" /><ref name="Jedi Alliance Pairs" />

===Post&ndash;Clone Wars===
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[New Order/Legends|transformed]] the Republic into the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and Christophsis became a reluctant but compliant member of the new government. However, the Outer Rim world remained independent of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and any future governments, all but ignoring the following galactic powers.<ref name="The Essential Atlas" />

==Inhabitants==
[[File:Christophsian.png|thumb|left|150px|A Christophsian refugee]]
The native inhabitants of Christophsis were the brown-skinned Christophsian [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]].<ref name="Databank" /><ref name="Shadowed" /> An arrogant people, the Christophsians hired aliens to help make their homeworld safer and advance mining-related technologies, but in an attempt to preserve their own profits, the Christophsis natives marginalized their partners after the surrounding asteroids were discovered to be rich in minerals. A commercially-concerned Christophsian oligarchy ruled Christophsis, and the world's leaders displayed their prowess in both manipulating the mineral markets and mining.<ref name="The Essential Atlas" />

Humans and alien [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;including Rodians and Kerkoidens&mdash;were among the [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] that immigrated to Christophsis. Rumors spread through the galaxy that the immigrants were little more than prisoners of the dominant and wealthy Christophsians, catering to their every need and doing their menial work. The people of Christophsis spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] and [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas" />

==Locations==
[[File:Crystal_City.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Crystal City]]
Several of Christophsis's cities could be seen from space as green, branching-out networks.<ref name="TCWf" /> The planet's cities included Chaleydonia, its capital city, which bore the more common name of Crystal City.<ref name="Shadow Games" /> As its name suggested, Crystal City appeared to be carved out of glittering gems.<ref name="TCWn" /> With the majority of its buildings built using crystals,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> the city was home to skyscraper<ref name="TCWn" /> residences<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode016.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Hidden Enemy}}</ref> and apartment buildings,<ref name="Art of SW:TCW" /> as well as a few plazas.<ref name="TCWn" /><ref name="Shadowed" /> The main site of the Battle of Christophsis, the Confederacy<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> and Republic were eventually both based in the city,<ref name="TCWn" /> with the former making headquarters out of a 23-story mansion.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Decoded" /> However, many parts of Crystal City were reduced to ruins during the Republic's liberation of the planet.<ref name="TCWf" /> Several bridges ran through the city, but many collapsed in the Separatist invasion. Numerous buildings,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> particularly along the city's central street, were also toppled and destroyed during the intense battle on the world.<ref name="TCWf" />

During the initial stages of the Battle of Christophsis, the Republic set up a networked base on the planet<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> before later moving directly into Crystal City.<ref name="TCWn" /> The base included a command center, a mess hall, and barracks for the Republic clone troopers.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> When the Separatists returned to Christophsis to mine for lightsaber crystals, they set up a base that ran deep underneath the surface of the world. Located close to the planet's core, the large facility was guarded by several battle droid squads.<ref name="Jedi Alliance" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I thought that when these people developed this area, they treated the crystals as trees, so some parts would be cut down and some parts would be integrated into the actual structure, like wood. Because of time and budget constraints, we were only able to develop one structure&mdash;a hexagon. We made each side unique, turned it, and stacked them side by side. When combined, there would be an unlimited number of structures.|[[Thang Le]] discusses modeling Christophsis's appearance|<ref name="Art of SW:TCW" />}}
[[File:Christophsis_concept.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Concept art of Christophsis]]
Christophsis was a planet created for the [[2008]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. It was originally to appear in a [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] "flashback" episode entitled "The New Padawan," but after [[George Lucas]] decided to debut the series in a [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|feature-length film]], the episode was moved to its proper chronological placement. The site of Anakin Skywalker's first meeting with his newly assigned Padawan, Ahsoka Tano,<ref name="Databank" /> Christophsis appears in the movie's promotional material, including the online [[LiveFire|''Live Fire'']] game and several young reader adaptations of the film.

The episode entitled "[[The Hidden Enemy]]" was later produced at Lucas's request to expand Christophsis's backstory and was aired with the television series' first season.<ref name="Art of SW:TCW" /> Christophsis also appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Shadowed|''Shadowed'']], which led into the episode. The planet was given roles in the 2008 [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance|''Jedi Alliance'']], as well as in the Nintendo DS edition of the [[2009]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' game, which expanded the events of ''The Clone Wars'' film and television series. Elements of Christophsis and its history were published in 2009's ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'' and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.

The crystalline appearance of Christophsis was based upon previously abandoned concepts of the planet [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] made during pre-production for [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Databank" /> The same concepts were later used in designing the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] for the television series' second season.<ref name="Complete Season Two">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]], "Creating Mandalore" DVD Featurette</ref>

===''Republic Heroes'' Nintendo DS edition inconsistencies===
One of the two missions depicting the Battle of Christophsis in the Nintendo DS version of ''Republic Heroes'' greatly contradicts ''The Clone Wars'' film and television series. The mission features [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and Anakin Skywalker arriving at Crystal City to investigate droid activity in the sector recently lost by the Republic. Skywalker and Amidala travel through the city until they face a force field blocking their way. Master Yoda then assists them by deactivating the field, and the two continue their way, eventually confronting [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] inside a Christophsian building. After a duel with Skywalker&mdash;whom Amidala assists with her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]&mdash;Dooku retreats.

During the duel with Dooku, however, Skywalker informs the unaware Count that the Confederate General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] plans to obtain a superweapon from beneath an ocean of [[Magma/Legends|lava]] on the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Skywalker finds out about Grievous's plans only during the [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|Mission to Skytop Station]], which takes place after the Battle of Christophsis has been already won by the Republic. Because of such confusing storyline that would take too much [[Fanon|speculation]] to implement into the pre-existing story, this article assumes that the video game's mission is non-[[canon]].
